Name: Flower Island Hut
Author: spotteddotted
Description:
Transforms the island hut into a brighter and flowery version!

Comes with two variants, including tropical hibiscuses and cherry blossoms!
In order to change which type it is, run the game, and then open the config.json in the mod folder and put either "Tropical" or "Cherry" in the "Flower Type" field! By default, this is set to "Tropical."

Content Patcher is a requirement.

Let me know if you have any mod suggestions or there are any mistakes
